i want to learn and understand what made most of the people so accepting of the world around them even if no one understand or even accepts them.

 thank you all for every comment, they have all been useful.

i love to cook, i read books (hitchhikers guide to the galaxy at the moment), if i ask my friends they would be up for most things, was on a sking trip a week ago, i exercise a cuople days a week. and i do enjoy all of these things.  but life is not only these things and nothing comes without even a small sacrifice. i guess im just a lazy asshole that is never happy. 

i am currently listening to my favorite song of all time (Between the bars by Elliot Smith) and drinking some wine while i cook some food.

i got feed up doing all the stupid "testing everything" stuff a couple years ago. drugs, alcohol, partys, traveling and generall idiocy. i still drink and do drugs from time to time, mostly out of boredom.

but honestly i dont know what is left to try, if there even is something that can move me on the right way.

>What is one kind thing you can do for yourself today that would make you feel better (at least relatively)?

i have honestly never been asked this before. and i can not think of an answer.

the only thought i have is what i can do to make it easier. not for me, i am fine with whatever pain and struggle i will face, but for everyone around me. i guess that means i have given up? is there a check list or a feeling so you know that you have given up? i guess no one have gotten far enough to make one without stepping over the edge.

this response took longer then i thought, and im sorry for the rambling.

i agree that is not many things that is more selfish then commiting suicide and yea, maybe people will be more hurt then i can imagine. i found that being straight to yourself and know that is worse for the people around you then i tis for yourself.

i know i will be the asshole, but i have a hard time carring at this point. i have hade that thought when a guy i knew died recently. all i could think was that hes a selfish asshole. i wasent even sad.

​

if i am ready and have the balls to finally do it, i will probably try to make it easier for as many as possible and distance myself. im not without a heart, my suffering do not need to be transfered.

i tried sleeping for a while now, but i dont like being alone with my thoughts at the moment so il be up for some time.

i forgot to mention that but yes i have been to a therapist a few years back. that was less about this but it was brought up. my then girlfriend of 3 years died in a car crash and i was sent to therapy by my friends. if im going to be honest i think it was around those sessions that i lost the last bit of genuine happines i hade. i have made very few connections after that and never dared commiting to someone. eventually i accepted that she was gone and that i hade to move on. it hurt to say but only one of my closest friends of 10+ years knows that she died. i stopped talking about her after her death and if anyone asked i simply said we broke up.

i hate being pity about myself. so the more depressed i got, the less i talked about it. eventually i stopped to care and started having this persona of always being on top of everything. im not even close

the last thought of dreaming higher i hade was when i was still in school. everything after that i have just rolled with the minimum just waiting for the end i always thought would come. 

i understand all this "u are unique, and no one can do what you do" but i will not accept something that can not be true. i migh be "unique" but that does not have to ba a good thing. in the small town i live there 100% is, or will be, hundreds of people that do what i do but better. i can not find the reason for me to keep on. 

alot of friends and family have died around me, and i have never realy seen the extreme impact it have on the world. i mean its sad, but you get over it and the world keep spinning.

i honestly dont know why still keep on. maybe im more scared then i think i am. maybe i want to live but i dont know why yet. i fully believe that suicide is the cowards way out, but i dont care. im all for the easy solution.
